title: A0 store/load and boundary-trap replay
statement: The recorded width-16 A0 traces store and reload 0xabcd in little-endian order, preserve memory on a dense boundary trap, write across the modular sparse addresses 65535 and 0, and preserve the complete sparse map when one required address is absent.

formal.statement: The dense trace records cd ab and reloads abcd; the sparse trace records addresses [65535,0] and bytes [cd,ab]; both invalid-range stores trap and preserve complete memory.

scope: Two width-16 successful stores, one following load, and two trapped stores: a dense four-byte boundary case and a sparse modular-wrap case with one required address absent.

evidence.note: The checker reruns dense and sparse successful and trapped states, including modular wrap and complete-map preservation. Reversing the observed stored bytes is rejected.
